$comment: Acceptance criteria for documentation content fixes. Verifies stale versions, removed tools, and wrong Node.js requirements are cleaned up.

criteria.target: test $(rg -c '2\.1\.[0-9]' docs/tutorials/ docs/how-to-guides/ docs/reference/ docs/explanation/ 2>/dev/null | wc -l) -eq 0
test $(rg -wc 'check_ai_execution_status' docs/tutorials/ docs/how-to-guides/ docs/reference/ docs/explanation/ 2>/dev/null | wc -l) -eq 0
